notes.title: Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date + new trailer!
notes.notes:
Greetings Zenozoik inhabitants and other Corwids!

We come to you with a quick news: [b]Clash: Artifacts of Chaos has a new release date! [/b]

Thanks to the community feedback during our two public demos, we were able to pinpoints facets of the game that could be reworked and balanced. With this, we've decided to give ourselves a couple more weeks to polish Clash, in order to give you the best experience possible.

Clash: Artifacts of Chaos is coming to PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Series X|S, and PC on
[h1][b]March 9, 2023[/b].[/h1]

Pre-orders for are now open on PlayStation & Xbox!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430680/Clash_Artifacts_of_Chaos/

notes.title: Zeno Clash XBLA Gets New Release Date, Trailer
notes.notes:
The enhanced Xbox 360 edition of ACE Team's first-person brawler Zeno Clash will be available as an Xbox Live Arcade download on May 5, publisher Atlus has confirmed.

The game, originally due in March, is billed as the "Ultimate Edition" as it packs a number of changes and improvements over the PC original, including balance tweaks, new weapons and a two-player co-op mode playable both online and via split-screen.

No word yet as to how much the download will run, but we do have a new trailer: Watch the HD video on Shackvideo.

Read More

notes.title: Zeno Clash's XBLA Release Is Delayed
notes.notes:
Perhaps you noticed that today Zeno Clash: Ultimate Edition was supposed to release on Xbox Live Arcade. Perhaps you noticed that it did not. "It's been pushed back a tad," says the developer.

"Sorry about that to everyone," wrote Andres Bordeu on the ACE Team forums. "It should come out early April. Atlus will be releasing more info through one of the next press releases. Just a little more patience, it'll be out really soon. As soon as we have new info we'll post it somewhere here."

The open world fighting game's Ultimate Edition adds new attacks, weapons, enemies and a new game mode. There is no word yet on pricing, but based on the price tag of its PC version, it could be around 1200 Microsoft Points.

Zeno Clash on XBLA Release Date? [ACE Team Forums via Eurogamer]

notes.title: Zeno Clash Update #3 released!
notes.notes:
Here are the new features & fixes:

-Added damage counter and timer for challenge mode. Damage counter warns player 20 HP before losing to personal record. Timer warns player 20 sec before losing to personal record
-Animal cruelty achievement fixed. Works as global counter
-Added Italian language and translation credits to the game
-Fixed crash when switching shadow quality in-game
-Player auto-locks on to F-M when health drops to zero (Single-Player)
-Tower Challenge F-M does not require lock-on to defeat
-Fixed throwing your weapon in maps where it causes problems
-Player returns to Challenge screen when dying in a tower level
-Fixed timer bug when pausing a Tower Challenge
-Tweaked collision detection for uppercut finisher and deflect kick
-Player now does attack sound when throwing weapons
-Moved health fruit in final map so it is easier to pick up

notes.title: Zeno Clash Update #2 released!
notes.notes:
Here are the new features / fixes:

- New feature: The player can throw the weapon with the 'block' key
- Added a manual lock-on option in the main menu
- Fixed grab items / autolock conflict (enemies can't be targeted when looking down)
- Player can now unlock by running backwards
- Balanced difficulty level of Tower challenges
- Final boss battle has a health fruit (slightly easier)
- Boss characters can grab the player when he is unlocked
- Fixed infinite kick exploit
- Fixed heavy opponents pains issue
